title: サイレンススズカ、覚醒①

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle watches on TV as Silence Suzuka faces off against Matikanefukukitaru in her first race after returning from Hong Kong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suzuka takes first place by a margin of over ten lengths, captivating the hearts of the spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Elated to see her friend win, Taiki Shuttle cheers and kicks off a party in celebration.
